title: Adaptive Evidential Meta-Learning with Hyper-Conditioned Priors for Calibrated ECG Personalisation

contributions.purpose: 在ECG模型个性化中提供校准良好的不确定性估计
contributions.mechanism: 在冻结ECG基础模型上加轻量证据头(Dirichlet),用超网络依据少样本患者的鲁棒类条件统计动态设定证据先验
contributions.evaluation: 定性:较基线降低ECE、保持竞争性F1(未给具体数值)
contributions.domain: ECG不确定性校准/个性化医疗
contributions.source_quote: We propose Adaptive Evidential Meta-Learning, a framework that attaches a lightweight evidential head with hyper-network-conditioned priors to a frozen ECG foundation model.

contributions.purpose: 应对真实世界域偏移与噪声
contributions.mechanism: 两阶段meta-curriculum:先在高质量临床任务训练,再在噪声真实变体上精炼
contributions.evaluation: 定性:消融显示class-conditional prior+两阶段curriculum显著降低ECE(无数值)
contributions.source_quote: We adopt a two-stage meta-curriculum—initially training on high-quality clinical tasks and subsequently refining on noisy real-world variants—to systematically address domain shifts.

contributions.purpose: 论证方法在效率与OOD检测上的优势
contributions.mechanism: 跨synthetic/clinical/wearable数据集评测ECE、准确率、OOD-AUC,并与fine-tuning、LoRA对比FLOPs与推理时间
contributions.evaluation: 自认准确率仅'modest gains',ECE与效率优于fine-tune/LoRA(数值未在正文给出)
contributions.source_quote: Our extensive experiments across synthetic, clinical, and wearable ECG datasets demonstrate improvements in Expected Calibration Error (ECE), accuracy, and OOD detection, highlighting critical pitfalls in existing adaptation methods.

self_declared_provenance.quote: In contrast to prior work, our approach uniquely integrates these components to address the pitfalls of mis-calibration while ensuring efficient adaptation.
